description: This file defines the 'I18NError' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing internationalization error records in the database with fields for 'name' and 'message', along with related constants for error types.

classes.name: I18NError
classes.description: Entity class representing internationalization errors with properties for name and message, mapped to the 'ohrm_i18n_error' database table, including constants for error types.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the error.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the error.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message associated with the error.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message for the error.
